mapper.select: select * from event_erp.survey where is_template = 1 order by template_key asc, survey_id asc limit 4
select name from user where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
select e.title from event_erp.survey s left join event_erp.event e on e.event_id = s.event_id where s.survey_id = #{surveyId}
select survey_id from event_erp.survey where event_id = #{eventId} order by open_at desc limit 1
select status from event_erp.survey where event_id = #{eventId} order by open_at desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into event_erp.survey_response (survey_id, user_id, responded_at) values (#{surveyId}, #{userId}, now())
insert into event_erp.survey_answer (response_id, question_id, option_id, answer_text) values (#{responseId}, #{questionId}, #{optionId}, #{answerText})

insert into event_erp.survey (event_id, title, description, status, is_anonymous, clone_from_survey_id, open_at, close_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at, is_template, template_key) select #{eventId}, concat('[복제] ', s.title), s.description, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, s.is_anonymous, s.survey_id, e.end_date, date_add(e.end_date, interval 7 day), #{userId}, now(), now(), 0, null from event_erp.survey s join event_erp.event e on e.event_id = #{eventId} where s.survey_id = #{templateId} and s.is_template = 1
select last_insert_id()

insert into event_erp.survey (event_id, title, description, status, is_anonymous, clone_from_survey_id, open_at, close_at, created_by, created_at, updated_at, is_template, template_key) values (#{eventId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, coalesce(#{isAnonymous},0), #{templateId}, #{openAt}, #{closeAt}, #{userId}, now(), now(), 0, null)
select last_insert_id()
mapper.select: select * from event_erp.vw_event_survey_reservation where user_id = #{userId} order by open_at desc
select * from event_erp.vw_event_survey_reservation_admin where survey_id = #{surveyId} order by event_id desc, survey_id desc

select e.event_id, e.title as event_title, s.survey_id, s.title as survey_title, s.open_at, s.close_at from event_erp.survey s left join event_erp.event e on e.event_id = s.event_id left join event_erp.survey_response r on r.survey_id = s.survey_id and r.user_id = #{userId} where r.response_id is null and (s.open_at is null or s.open_at <= now()) and (s.close_at is null or s.close_at >= now()) and s.event_id is not null order by (s.open_at is null) asc, s.open_at desc, s.survey_id desc
